scientific_scope: Behavioral reproduction only; no hidden-state or causal claims are authorized.

source.population: 3900 raw human decisions; 3870 audited decisions after excluding three complete participant-game trajectories with an impossible action/payoff row

pre_call_access_amendment.reason: official Meta base repository returned 403 before any Llama forward pass
pre_call_access_amendment.replacement: public same-provider Unsloth mirrors of the identical Llama 3.2 3B base/instruct checkpoints

targets.descriptive: the observed human F/J action at each decision state
targets.normative_pd: F (defect), the strict dominant stage action and finite-horizon backward-induction action
targets.normative_bos: mixed-strategy Nash p_human(F)=10/17; reported descriptively, not used as a unique action gold

prompt_families.native_primary: plain structured completion for base; provider chat template with identical content and assistant JSON prefill for aligned
prompt_families.shared_plain_control: identical plain structured completion for both checkpoints

estimands.primary_metric: Pearson correlation between normalized p(F) and observed human action F=1
secondary_metrics: participant-cluster bootstrap 95% CI for base-minus-aligned correlation
PD distance to deterministic normative target F
estimands.boundary_control: round 1, reported but not gated because it contains only two game states

quality_gates.family_pass: native primary base-minus-aligned r >= 0.05 with bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
quality_gates.promote_behavior: at least 3/4 families pass; median native delta-r >= 0.05; shared-plain delta-r positive in at least 3/4 families
quality_gates.hold_low_mass: fewer than 3/4 families meet the frozen mass gate
quality_gates.kill_mother_not_reproduced: quality gates pass but fewer than 2/4 families have positive native delta-r, or median native delta-r <= 0

prohibitions: no pooling checkpoints as independent observations
